Overall, it's a very happy stay, and I am looking forward to coming back in the future.

The breakfast is so-so, with a fairly complete selection of traditional food. Bakery, savory snacks, espresso machine coffee, sticky rice porridge, noodles, and a complete salad are available. The room is clean and the TV is okay, big. We should have stayed here for 2 nights. It's close to a supermarket, Martadinata. Good for hanging out, BIP. Next time we will come back here again. The price happens to be cheap on weekdays. Weekends are still standard... Thank you, Santika. The staff is friendly.

text_review: Kami pernah menginap di sini sebelumnya, namun tidak seperti yang kami ingat. Kedap suara kamar sangat perlu diatasi, malam pertama kami tamu hotel lain mengganggu tidur kami karena mereka masih diperbolehkan berenang pada jam 12 pagi, yang tepat di depan kamar kami. Kami meminta untuk pindah kamar pada malam ke-2 tetapi kami dapat mendengar suara keras sepeda motor yang lewat. Perlengkapan saniter kamar mandi juga perlu diperbarui, salah satu kepala pancurannya terjatuh sementara yang lain memiliki handuk bernoda. Layanan kamar rata-rata. Kami diberitahu bahwa hotel sedang melakukan renovasi secara bertahap, tapi kami benar-benar mendesak hotel untuk mendapatkan solusi kedap suara, ini benar-benar merupakan hal penting yang harus disediakan oleh hotel mana pun dengan peringkat bintang (3).
text_review_original: We stayed here before but it was not how we remembered it to be. Room sound proofing really need to be solve, our 1st night other hotel guests disturb our sleep as they still allowed to swim at 12am, which is right in front of our room. We asked to change room on the 2nd night but we could hear the loud motorcycles passing by. Bathroom sanitary wares also needed update, one of the shower head had the fittings fell off while the other had a stained towel. Room service was average. We were informed that the hotel is doing renovation by stages, but we really urged the hotel to get the sound proofing resolve, its really an essential thing any hotel with (3) star rating should provide.

text_review: Ini bukan pertama kalinya kami menginap di hotel ini. Hal itu sendiri menjelaskan banyak hal. Berdasarkan standar kota Bandung yang terus berkembang, hotel ini bukanlah hotel baru. Gaya arsitekturnya berbeda dibandingkan dengan banyak hotel lain di Bandung. Hotelnya nyaman untuk keluarga. Memiliki kolam renang, kamar yang luas, sarapan enak, dan staf yang ramah. Namun bagi kebanyakan orang, nilai utama adalah lokasinya: jarak berjalan kaki ke banyak tempat utama di Bandung, termasuk pusat perbelanjaan, restoran, dan gerai mode.
text_review_original: This is not the first time we stayed at the hotel. That in itself tells a lot. By the standard of the ever-developing Bandung, the hotel is not new. It is of a different architectural style compared to many other hotels in Bandung. The hotel is comfortable for family. It has swimming pool, spacious rooms, nice breakfast, and friendly staff. For most people, however, the main value is the location: it is of walking distance to many of Bandung main sites, including shopping mall, restaurants, and fashion outlets.

WiFi tersedia di seluruh gedung dan ruangan tetapi tidak stabil (Anda harus masuk kembali setelah beberapa saat), mencoba mengunduh peta (100MB) untuk GPS saya tetapi tidak pernah selesai karena hal ini. WiFi is available throughout the building and rooms but unstable (you'll need to re-login after a short period of time), was trying to download map (100MB) for my GPS but never got finished due to this. My room is just opposite of the housekeeping room, some might find disturbance due to their housekeeping activities.

Sebenarnya saya belum pernah sarapan disini, tapi menurut saya standar seperti hotel lainnya.

Full support situation and nice also. The room good enough, not too large but exactly as I expected. Good and clean bathroom. Actually I never have breakfast here, but I think it is standard like other hotels.

Namun lokasi hotel sangat bagus, dalam jarak berjalan kaki ke factory outlet, Bandung Indah Plaza dan ke tempat favorit kami dengan hidangan khasnya "Nasi Tulang Jambal"... Hal lain yang membuat kami terkesan adalah menu sarapannya yang beragam, antrinya banyak dan rasanya cukup enak..

On the other hand their fitness facility is not reflect their status as a 4 Star hotel.However the hotel location was very good, its within walking distance to go to factory outlets, Bandung Indah Plaza and to our favorite place with its signature dish "Nasi Tulang Jambal"... The other thing that impress us is their variety menu on breakfast, its queit a lot and taste good enough..

text_review: secara umum, senang rasanya menginap di hotel santika. alangkah baiknya jika tidak ada nyamuk di dalam kamar dan ganti handuk lama dengan yang baru dan sedikit lebih besar.
text_review_original: generally, it was good to stay in santika hotel. it will be great if no mosquitos in the room and replace the old towel with a new and bit bigger.

text_review: Lokasi Terbaik untuk Mengunjungi Factory Outlet di Bandung. Anda bisa berjalan kaki mengunjungi beberapa Factory Outlet Terbaik di Bandung
text_review_original: Best Location to Visit Factory Outlet in Bandung. You could walked to visit several Best Factory Outlet in Bandung

text_review: staf layanan sopan dan berpengetahuan. Terletak di seberangnya adalah persimpangan riau, pusat perbelanjaan kecil yang memadai dengan pasar super dan tempat makan.
text_review_original: service staff was polite and knowledgable. Situated opposite is riau junction, an adequate smallish shopping center with a super market and food joints.

text_review: Masa menginap saya luar biasa. Kamarnya bersih, pelayanan dari stafnya luar biasa, bahkan mereka menyediakan antar-jemput gratis ke stasiun kereta. Terletak di Dago yang merupakan salah satu kawasan terpenting dan sibuk di Bandung, Santika akan memberikan Anda pergerakan paling nyaman ketika mengunjungi Bandung. Namun, sarapannya tidak begitu menarik.
text_review_original: My stay was amazing. The room was clean, service from the staff was great, even they provide a free shuttle to train station. Located in Dago which is one of the most important and busy area in Bandung, Santika will give you the most convenient movement when visiting Bandung. However, the breakfast was not that interesting.

text_review: Hotel yang bagus, dekat factory outlet jalan riaw bandung. Makanannya sangat enak dengan harga terjangkau. Pasti akan kembali lagi pada kunjungan saya berikutnya ke Bandung.
text_review_original: A nice hotel, near the factory outlets of Jalan Riauw Bandung. The food is very good with reasonable prices. Will definitively come back again on my next visit to Bandung.

text_review: Nikmati masa menginap dengan staf yang membantu. Telah ditingkatkan ke kamar suite. Kondisi toilet perlu dilakukan renovasi karena sudah tua. Secara keseluruhan, kamar hotel yang bagus dengan staf yang membantu dan ramah.
text_review_original: Enjoy the stay with helpful staff. Got upgraded to suite room. Toilet condition needed to do renovation as its already old. Overalls great hotel room with helpful and friendly staff.

text_review: Lokasi bagus dan pusat perbelanjaan. Dari sini, kita dapat mengakses pusat perbelanjaan lain dengan taksi atau angkutan lokal dengan biaya sekitar Ind $ atau US sekitar 20 sen. Untuk taksi menuju pasar lokal, biayanya sekitar Ind $ atau sekitar US $2. perjalanan memakan waktu sekitar 20 menit. Ada banyak factory outlet di dekat Hotel Santika. Staf hotel sangat ramah dan mampu memberikan nasihat yang baik mengenai makanan lokal, tempat-tempat menarik di sekitar area dan juga tempat-tempat menarik.
text_review_original: Good location and shopping center. From here, we can accessible to other shopping center by taxi or local transportation which cost about Ind $ or US about 20 cents. For the taxi going to local market, it cost about Ind $or about US $2. the journey takes about 20 min. There are a lot of factory outlet near the Hotel Santika. The hotel staff are very friendly and able to give good advice on local food, interesting places around the area and also place of of interest.

text_review: Kamarnya cukup kecil tapi bersih. Saya memilih hotel ini karena dekat dengan tempat pertemuan bisnis saya. Sarapan yang disajikan enak, mereka mengubah menu setiap hari.
text_review_original: Rooms are quite small but clean. I choose this hotel because it's near to my bussines meeting place. The breakfasr served was nice, they change the menu everyday.

text_review: Masa menginap kami menyenangkan, stafnya sangat ramah & makanannya lezat. Direkomendasikan untuk pelancong solo & keluarga.
text_review_original: Our stay are pleasent, the staff are so friendly & food are delicious. Recommended for solo & family travellers.

text_review: hotel yang bagus dengan staf yang baik. Hanya perlu membayar untuk layanan pengepresan. Sebaiknya berikan setrika gratis ke setiap kamar.
text_review_original: good hotel with good staff. Just need to pay for pressing service. Should give free iron to every room.

text_review: Semuanya bagus, mulai dari reservasi hingga waktu check out. Meskipun ada beberapa kesalahan kecil yang dilakukan front office. Saya minta di bangunkan jam 12 malam, karena kami belum tidur sampai jam 7 pagi. FO tidak membuat pemberitahuan kepada semua, untuk tidak mengganggu kamar kami. Maka tidak heran saya mendapat telepon dua kali dari orang lain (Spa dan Sarapan Wanita) di waktu yang berbeda menanyakan layanan mereka.
text_review_original: All is great, start from the recervation until check out times. Although there are some small mistaken that front office made. I ask to have a wake up call at 12 pm, due we haven't sleep until 7 in the morning. The FO not make a notice to all, to not distrub our rooms.Then no wonder i have a twice call from others (Spa and Breakfast Lady) in different times asking they service.

text_review: it is lookks 3 stars hotel not 4 star also it is nosy not quite
text_review_original: it is lookks 3 stars hotel not 4 star also it is nosy not quite

text_review: Bagus..menyenangkan..lokasi bagus..hotel nyaman dan nyaman. Makanan enak disajikan.
text_review_original: Nice..pleasant..good location..cozy and comfortable hotel. Nice food served.

text_review: Lokasi bagus dan sarapan disajikan berdasarkan makanan lokal. Jarak jalan kaki ke factory outlet, sekitar kurang dari 100 meter. Harus mencoba restoran lokal di dekat factory outlet. Berbeda dengan hotel lain, di Hotel Santika, kami tidak dapat meminta perpanjangan lebih dari 1 jam misalnya maksimal 2 jam meskipun hotel tersebut tidak terisi penuh. Harus mencari air panas di kamar mandi karena pada hari terakhir kami menginap, air berubah warna "coklat". Staf hotel berhasil menyelesaikan masalah tetapi perhatikan.
text_review_original: Good location and breakfast are served base on local food. Walking distance for factory outlet, about less than 100meters. Should try local restaurant near factory outlet. Unlike other hotel, at Hotel Santika, we can't ask extention more than 1 hr example 2 hr max eventhough the hotel is not fully occupied. Have to look up the hot water in bathroom as on our last day of stay,the water turns "brown" colour. The hotel staff managed to resolve the problem but do take note.

text_review: hotel santika bandung terletak tepat di seberang pusat perbelanjaan dengan supermarket sehingga sangat nyaman bagi kami untuk mengambil makanan cepat saji atau air dan makanan ringan. hotel ini juga terletak tepat di tengah-tengah area perbelanjaan dengan banyak factory outlet di kiri dan kanan kami. berjalan di sepanjang jalan sangat nyaman.
text_review_original: hotel santika bandung is located just opposite a shopping mall with a supermarket so it was very convenient for us to grab quick meals or some water and snacks. the hotel is also located right smack in the middle of the shopping area with many factory outlets to our left and right. walking along the streets was very convenient.

text_review: Itu adalah waktu yang ramai selama Idul Fitri namun staf tetap menjaga pelayanan yang baik. Sayangnya kami tidak bisa mendapatkan tempat tidur king size yang jumlahnya terbatas. (berharap itu diinformasikan di web agoda).
text_review_original: It was a crowded time during Ied and yet the staff maintain the good services. Unfortunately we couldn't get the king size bed which was limited in number. (wish it was informed in the agoda web).

text_review: ini pengalaman menginap yang menyenangkan. hotel ini kecil tapi nyaman untuk menginap karena dekat dengan area perbelanjaan. sarapannya sederhana dan menyenangkan
text_review_original: it was such a nice stay. the hotel is a small but convinient to stay as near to shopping area. the breakfast was simple and nice

text_review: Saya ingin mengatakan bahwa saya cukup senang dengan layanan ini. Semua staf ramah dan memberi saya layanan terbaik mereka. Lokasinya juga sangat bagus, dekat dengan FO dan juga beberapa kafe. Kolam renangnya tidak begitu bagus, saya mencoba berenang tetapi airnya sangat dingin brrrr dan juga sangat kecil. Berhati-hatilah saat memarkir mobil Anda, pastikan Anda parkir di tempat parkir yang memiliki langit-langit.
text_review_original: I would like to say that i am quite happy with the services. All staffs were friendly and provide me with their best service. The location was also so great, near to the FO and also several cafes. Swimming pool is not so good, i tried to swim but the water was freezing brrrr and very small as well. Be careful when you park your car, ensure that you park at the parking lot with ceiling.

text_review: Hotelnya cukup tua namun masih terawat, berada di pusat kota, dan dilayani oleh staf yang sangat ramah. Dekat dengan beberapa factory outlet dan restoran. Lokasi tepat di depan Riau Junction, Supermarket, jalan dago (Juanda) dan BIP Mall. Kebersihan hotel ini sangat baik. Sarapan di hotel juga menarik.
text_review_original: The hotel is quite old but still preserved, is in the center of town, and served by very friendly staff. Near to several factory outlet and restaurant. The location right in front of Riau Junction, Supermarket, dago street (Juanda) and BIP Mall. The cleanliness of this hotel is very good. Breakfast at the hotel is also interesting.

text_review: Kami menginap 2 malam di Hotel Santika. Rupanya ini lebih untuk penduduk lokal karena kami tidak bertemu banyak orang asing. Mereka memiliki transfer bandara gratis dan sarapan prasmanan yang cukup beragam. Kamarnya bersih dengan banyak program TV & WIFI gratis. Walaupun bahasa Inggris staf hotel kurang bagus, mereka cepat dalam pelayanan kamar. Hotel ini sangat nyaman. Dalam 5 menit berjalan kaki terdapat Supermarket Plaza & Matahari. Jarak berjalan kaki ke outlet Rahasia. Hotel Santika berada di persimpangan & sehingga kami dapat mendengar jalan yang sibuk. Selanjutnya kita bisa mendengar suara pesawat terbang di atas kita.
text_review_original: We had 2 nights stay at Hotel Santika. Apparently it is more for locals as we didn't meet many foreigners. They have free airport transfer and quite a variety of buffet breakfast. The room is clean with many TV programs & free WIFI. Although the hotel staffs' English are not good, they are fast in room service. The hotel is very convenient. Within 5 mins walk is their Plaza & Matahari Supermarket. Walking distance to Secrets outlet. Hotel Santika is at a cross junction & thus we could hear the busy road. Furthermore, we can hear the airplance flying above us.

text_review: kami menginap selama 2 malam di hotel ini, lokasi sangat dekat dengan factory outlet dan restoran. saya mendapat akomodasi keluarga ugrade dengan 2 kamar, bukan 2 kamar dengan pintu penghubung.
text_review_original: we stayed for 2 nights in this hotel, the location is very close to the factory outlets and restaurants. i got an ugrade family accomodation with 2 rooms instead of 2 rooms with connecting door.

text_review: D hotel dekat dengan banyak objek wisata, seperti taman lalu lintas, mall, museum geologi, restoran, cafe dan. outlet pabrik di luar jalur. Menu sarapannya biasa saja, tapi cukup baik untuk anak-anak. Sayangnya bagi kami, jus apel terasa sangat asam. Dengan desain kesederhanaan kamar yang telah direnovasi, terdapat cukup ruang untuk tempat tidur tambahan dan tas serta 'area anak-anak'..
text_review_original: D hotel close to many tourist objects, like as taman lalu lintas, mall, museum geologi, restaurants, cafe and. offcourse factories outlets. Breakfast menu so so, but good enough for kids. Unfortunatelly for us, apple juice was so sour. W/ simplicity design renovated room, there's enough space for extrabed and bags and 'kids area'..

text_review: saya sangat senang menginap di hotel santika. kamarnya bagus, nyaman dan yang paling penting bersih. ketika kami tiba, kami disambut oleh staf yang membantu dan menyenangkan. hotel ini memiliki lokasi yang bagus dan rapi ke pusat perbelanjaan dan supermarket. meja depan membantu kami dalam memutuskan untuk naik taksi atau menyewa mobil dan sopir setiap jam. dia membantu kami menghitung bahwa sewa mobil per jam jauh lebih baik karena tidak ada pelancong yang saya miliki di grup saya. saya akan merekomendasikan teman saya untuk menginap di santika jika mereka mengunjungi bandung.
text_review_original: i am very happy to have stayed at santika hotel. the room is nice,cosy and most importantly clean. when we arrived, we were greated by helpful and pleasant staff. the hotel has goo location and is neat to shopping centre and supermarket. the frontdesk assisted us in deciding to take the cab or rent a car and driver by hourly. she helped us calculate that car rental with hourly is much better with the no of travellers i have in my group. i will recommend my friends to stay at santika if they ever visit bandung.

text_review: stafnya sangat ramah, terutama meja depannya bagus. lokasinya agak jauh dari stasiun tapi dekat dengan pusat perbelanjaan. untuk sarapan, saya ingin menu yang lebih banyak pilihan. fasilitasnya bagus. saya akan mempertimbangkan untuk tinggal di sana lagi ketika saya kembali ke bandung tahun depan.
text_review_original: staff is so friendly,especially front desk is good. location is far a little from station but near the shopping center. for breakfast, i want more choiceable menu. amenities were good. i will consider staying there again on my return to bandung next year.

text_review: hotel yang terletak di jantung kota Bandung, dikelilingi oleh kawasan perbelanjaan dan beragam makanan. pengalaman menginap yang sangat menyenangkan bersama Santika Bandung dan akan merekomendasikan hotel ini kepada siapa pun yang pergi ke Bandung untuk pengalaman berbelanja dan kuliner. secara keseluruhan pengalaman menginap yang sangat menyenangkan
text_review_original: the hotel located at the very heart of Bandung, surrounded by shopping district and food galore. very enjoyable stay with Santika Bandung and would recommend the hotel to anyone going to Bandung for shopping and culinary experience. overall very pleasant stay

text_review: Hotel yang bagus untuk menginap bersama keluarga, terdapat kolam renang dan restoran yang menyenangkan juga mudah dijangkau kemana-mana seperti pusat perbelanjaan, butik fashion dan kulinery
text_review_original: Nice hotel to stay with family, there was a pool and a delight restaurant also easy to go to everywhere such as shopping mall, fashion boutique and kulinery

text_review: pertama kali menggunakan hotel ini. ini adalah hotel tua tapi stafnya sangat ramah. saya mendapat upgrade karena ada yang terlambat check-out. kamarnya rata-rata, tapi cukup layak. agak bising di pagi hari karena kamar saya tepat di atas kolam renang.
text_review_original: first time using this hotel. it is a old hotel but the staff was super friendly. i've got upgrade because someone's late check-out. room was average, but decent enough. a bit noisy in the morning because my room was just on top of the swimming pool.

text_review: Lokasi bagus dengan banyak tempat belanja yang bisa dilakukan di siang dan malam hari. Staf hotel ramah dan memberikan nasihat dan petunjuk yang baik tentang tempat dan hal yang harus dilakukan. Ini adalah perjalanan pertama saya ke Bandung jadi bantuan mereka sangat penting. Bersulang
text_review_original: Good location with many shoppings to do in day and night. Hotel staff was friendly and gives good advice and directions on places and things to do. This was my first trip to Bandung so their help was very important. Cheers

text_review: secara keseluruhan, saya memiliki pengalaman yang baik menginap di sini. ini adalah hotel tua, jadi fasilitasnya sudah ketinggalan zaman. namun mereka mencoba memperbarui interiornya (TV layar datar, seprai bersih, sofa baru, dll). umumnya bersih. Aku menemukan sesuatu yang awalnya tampak seperti pasir di dekat rangka tempat tidur, dan kemudian aku menyadari bahwa itu adalah butiran kayu. saya curiga mungkin ada rayap. saya memesan kamar deluxe bisnis. kamarnya luas tapi mejanya sangat kecil, dan tidak ada bak mandi. pemandangan dari kamar (# 119) buruk: tembok tetangga. lokasinya luar biasa, tepat di pusat kota. berjalan kaki ke bip mall dan pusat factory outlet (jalan riau). pilihan menu layanan kamar sangat buruk. namun, ketika ada begitu banyak restoran bagus di luar hotel, makan di luar menjadi mudah. mini barnya sangat jarang diisi. jika ingin tidur di akhir pekan hindari kamar di lantai 1, karena bersebelahan dengan kolam renang yang paginya ramai dikunjungi anak-anak. panggilan jam 9 setiap hari untuk menawarkan perawatan spa agak mengganggu. stafnya luar biasa: sangat sopan, penuh hormat dan membantu. apakah saya akan tinggal di sana lagi? mungkin tidak.
text_review_original: overall, i had a good experience staying here. it is an old hotel, so facilities are dated. but they try to update the interior (flat screen tv, clean bedsheets, new sofa, etc). it is generally clean. i found what-at-first looked like sand near the bedframe, and later i realized they were wood granules. i suspect there may be termites. i booked a business deluxe room. the room was spacious but the table is very small, and has no bath tub. the view from the room (# 119) was bad: a neighbor wall. the location is superb, right in the city center. a walking distance to bip mall and the factory outlet center (jalan riau). the choice of room service menu is very poor. however, when there are so many good restaurants outside the hotel, eating out is easy. the mini bar was very sparsely stocked. if you want to sleep in on weekends, avoid rooms on the first floor, as they are next to the swimming pool which was very crowded with children in the morning. the daily 9 o'clock calls to offer you the spa treatment was a bit annoying. the staff were fantastic: very courteous, respectful and helpful. would i stay there again? probably not.

text_review: Jika alasan Anda bepergian ke Bandung adalah Factory Outlet, Hotel Santika Bandung adalah pilihan yang tepat.. Hanya beberapa menit dari Jalan Riau..
text_review_original: If the reasons you travel to Bandung is Factory Outlet, Hotel Santika Bandung is a great choices.. It's minutes away from Jalan Riau..

text_review: Saya memilih hotel ini karena lokasinya, terletak dalam jarak berjalan kaki ke jalan riau, salah satu jalan paling terkenal untuk berbelanja di factory outlet. saya melihat gambar kamar dan fasilitas yang tampak modern dan bagus. di pagi hari saya menerima email dari eksekutif penjualan hotel. pesannya sangat ramah dan informatif, dia bahkan memberi saya peta bandung. pesannya "hotel santika bandung semuanya sudah direnovasi total baik interior maupun eksteriornya. untuk lantainya kita tidak lagi menggunakan karpet tapi sekarang menggunakan parket." check in hotelnya tenang mudah, lobinya bagus, tapi masalah mulai setelah itu. liftnya cuma muat 3 - 4 orang, tua dan bau. area umum selain lobi juga tua dan bau. kamarnya mengecewakan, lebih seperti furnitur finishing baru, tv lcd sekitar 22" lebih kecil dari monitor komputer saya, kamar mandi tidak direnovasi, bak mandi dan lemari tua. ada aksesoris baru tapi terlihat murahan dan tidak bermerek. bagaimana mereka bisa bilang sudah direnovasi total? dan akhirnya kaget, kaget bukan lantai karpet tapi juga lantai parket. itu lantai keramik motif kayu. keramiknya paling jelek dari karpet, harganya juga lebih murah, keras dan dingin di malam hari. kebanyakan hotel baru di bandung sudah menggunakan lantai marmer sekitar 10 kali lipat lebih mahal daripada keramik. secara keseluruhan saya mencoba sangat menyukai hotel ini. Saya percaya jika mereka tidak memberi saya informasi yang menyesatkan, hotel ini dapat dinilai sebagai rata-rata tetapi karena menyesatkan - mengakui - maka tidak mengucapkan sepatah kata pun sesudahnya.
text_review_original: i chose the hotel for its location, it was placed within walking distance to riau street, one of the most famous street for factory outlet shopping. i see nice modern looking room and facilities pictures. in the morning i receive an email from sales executive of the hotel. the message was very friendly and informative, she even provide me map of bandung. the message said "hotel santika bandung have all been totally renovated, interior or exterior. for the floor we no longer using carpet but now using parquet."the hotel check in is quiet easy, the lobby is great, but the problem start after that. the lift only fit 3 - 4 people, old and smelly. the common area other than lobby also old and smelly. the room are disappointing, more like new finishing furniture, lcd tv about 22" smaller than my computer monitor, the bathroom were not renovated, old bathtub and closet. there was new accessories but it looks cheap and unbranded. how can they say it was totally renovated? and finally surprise, surprise not carpet floor but not parquet floor either. it was ceramics floor with wood motif. ceramics are worst than carpet, its cheaper also, its hard and cold at night. most new hotel in bandung already using marble floor its about 10 times more expensive than ceramics.all in all i tried to like this hotel very much i believe if they didn't give me a misleading information this hotel can be rate as average. but from being misleading - admitting - then didn't say any word afterward.

text_review: Minuman selamat datangnya cocok untuk pelancong yang baru pertama kali ke Bandung. Lokasinya terpusat dengan mal besar yang mencakup toko butik dan supermarket serta supermarket Cina. pembelian menit terakhir untuk belanja menit terakhir untuk barang-barang pribadi dan makanan khas indonesia.
text_review_original: The welcome drink is good for first time travellers to Bandung. It is centrally located with a mega mall that includes boutique shops and supermarket and a chinese supermarket. last minute purchases for last minute shopping for personal effects and speciality food of indonesia.

text_review: berlokasi sentral ke sebagian besar toko factory outlet dengan mal besar toko butik di dalam mal dan supermarket di mal. di seberang jalan dari hotel ada supermarket Cina.
text_review_original: centrally located to most of the factory outlet shops with mega mall of boutique shops within the mall and a supermarket in the mall. across the road from hotel is a chinese supermarket.

text_review: hotel ini terletak di tengah kota bandung di mana Anda dapat berjalan kaki ke factory outlet terdekat.
text_review_original: the hotel located in d middle of bandung where you can literally walk to the nearby factory outlet.

text_review: lokasi bagus, dekat dengan mall dan lokasi kerja yang ingin saya tuju. pelayanan ramah ramah. dan banyak situs yang menyediakan kuliner enak
text_review_original: good location, close to the mall and the location work that I want to go. friendly friendly service. and many sites provide a good culinary

text_review: Tempat menginap yang bagus di bandung, sangat direkomendasikan untuk keluarga menginap disini. Lokasinya bagus, Anda bisa mengunjungi banyak factory outlet di dekatnya. Anda dapat dengan mudah menemukan makanan di sekitar hotel. Hotelnya bersih, pegawainya sangat membantu.
text_review_original: Nice place to stay in Bandung, very recommended for families to stay here. The location is good, you can visit a lot of factory outlets nearby. You can easily find food at the surroundings of the hotel. The hotel is clean, the staffs are very helpfull.

text_review: Saya menginap hanya 1 (satu) malam namun tampaknya sangat terkesan dengan keramahtamahan staf hotel. lokasi hotel ini sempurna. tepat di pusat kota bandung. ada satu pusat perbelanjaan besar tepat di depannya.
text_review_original: i stay only 1(one)night but seem to be very impressed with hotel staff hospitality.they arrange my transport go to airport in tearly morning quite perfect in time.breakfast was normal as standard 4 star hotel but staff ,again,is very proffesional packgacing my breakfast in the box so i could carry on for flight. this hotel location was perfect.right in the down town of bandung.there is one big shopping mall just right in front.

text_review: Seperti pada review saya di atas hotel yang bagus dan menyenangkan dengan staf yang sangat membantu tetapi kurang fasilitas hotel bintang empat. Paling nyaman bagi mereka yang suka berbelanja di Factory Outlet Jalan Riau karena jaraknya dapat dicapai dengan berjalan kaki. Ada juga Pusat Perbelanjaan dan Supermarket di seberang jalan.
text_review_original: As in my above review a nice and pleasant hotel with very helpful staff but lack a four star hotel facilities. Most convenient for those who like to shop at Jalan Riau Factory Outlets as it is within walking distance. There are also Shopping Malls and SuperMarkets just across the streets.

text_review: saya dan keluarga saya menikmati kami menginap di hotel Santika. kamar kami bagus dan bersih. Pasti akan tinggal di sana lagi.
text_review_original: i and my family enjoyed our stay at Santika hotel. the rooms we nice and clean. Would defanately stay there again.

text_review: Saya pergi ke sana untuk bekerja, dan stafnya luar biasa dan saya tidak punya apa-apa untuk dikatakan. Untuk sarapannya banyak masakan Indonesia, jadi bisa menikmati nuansa lokal. Namun, bangunannya sudah agak tua.
text_review_original: 仕事でりようしましたが、スタッフの対応も素晴らしく、言うことなしでした。朝食は、インドネシア料理も多く、地元感も楽しめます。ただ、建物は少し古いです。

TV layarnya terlalu kecil, tempat tidur besar namun sudah tidak begitu nyaman. AC berfungsi dengan baik. Free wifi di dalam kamar dengan koneksi yang bagus. text_review: Kami memiliki pengalaman yang sangat baik selama kami menginap dua malam, meskipun hotel sudah penuh dipesan (akhir pekan lalu sebelum liburan sekolah). Semuanya bersih dan terorganisir dengan baik meskipun ada banyak orang. Prasmanannya luar biasa, dengan beragam masakan Jawa dan Indonesia. Lokasinya sangat bagus: tepat di sebelah Kebun Raya dan dua pusat perbelanjaan. Kejutan yang menyenangkan di Indonesia: orang-orang berjalan kaki, jogging, dan bersepeda mengelilingi Kebun Raya pada malam hari. Hotel ini memiliki kolam renang dan ruang kebugaran kecil. Stafnya luar biasa dan sangat membantu. Kami mempunyai masalah dengan ruangan yang berbau asap, tetapi mereka dengan cepat memindahkan kami dan mengurus semuanya. Saya pikir orang-orang Eropa lebih terbiasa dengan ruang bebas rokok. Saya berharap hal ini juga menjadi lebih umum di Indonesia.
text_review_original: We had a very good experience during our two-night stay, even though the hotel was fully booked (last weekend before the school holidays). Everything was clean and well-organized despite the crowds. The buffet was amazing, with a wide variety of Javanese and Indonesian dishes. The location is excellent: right next to the Botanical Gardens and two shopping malls. A pleasant surprise in Indonesia: people walk, jog, and cycle around the Botanical Gardens in the evening. The hotel has a pool and a small fitness room. The staff was wonderful and very helpful. We had an issue with a room that smelled of smoke, but they quickly moved us and took care of everything. I think Europeans are more used to smoke-free spaces. I hope this becomes more common in Indonesia too.

text_review: Keramahan yang luar biasa, kamar bersih. Lokasi sangat bagus jika Anda ingin berada dekat mal dan tempat makan. Staf luar biasa, fokus pada tamu. Memiliki akses ke mal. text_review_original: Great hospitality, clean room. Very good location if you like to be near the mall and eating places. Exceptional staff, guest focussed. Has access to mall. A hotel that i will definitely recommend to my loved ones. Will stay here again if in Bogor.

We would happily return for another stay, planned or not!

text_review_original: Rating: 4/5 The room was a bit old but overall okay—clean and well-maintained. The bathroom, especially the shower, worked just fine. Food was decent, nothing special but acceptable. What really stood out was the service. All the staff were kind, warm, and very helpful throughout our stay. One unique perk was the exclusive access to Botani Square, which was a nice touch. The only downside was the lobby. It felt quite small and didn't give off an exclusive or premium vibe, which could be improved. Overall, a comfortable stay with great service!

text_review: Kami selalu tinggal di sini untuk perjalanan singkat karena nyaman untuk bersantai di dekat toko-toko kafe dll. Juga dekat bus ke bandara. Sarapan hotel bervariasi. Akan tinggal lagi.

text_review: Saya mendapatkan pengalaman menginap yang menyenangkan di Santika Hotel Bogor. Hotel ini menawarkan lokasi yang bagus, terhubung ke Mall dengan akses mudah ke tempat-tempat wisata utama kota dan lingkungan sekitar yang indah. Overall, it’s a perfect place to relax and enjoy a pleasant stay in Bogor."

Satu kekurangannya adalah kolam renang hanya buka pada jam 7 pagi, yang mungkin akan terlambat jika Anda ingin berolahraga sebelum sarapan dan pertemuan lebih awal. text_review_original: The hotel is right next to a mall, making it very easy to grab lunch or dinner. It’s also close to Taman Raya Bogor, which is great for a quick visit. One downside is that the swimming pool only opens at 7 AM, which may be too late if you want to get in some exercise before breakfast and early meetings. The breakfast buffet offers a nice variety of delicious food. Overall, the hotel seems ideal for a family weekend stay, as I noticed several families with children during my visit.

text_review_original: Nice stay, be aware that if you are driving by yourself, parking a little challenge. If you park outside it might get dirty with rain and leaves. If you park inside, you are at same space as Mall Customers.

text_review: Lokasinya bersebelahan dengan Botani Square Mall dan pusat kota Bogor, sehingga mudah untuk mendapatkan makanan dan berbelanja. Hotel ini menyediakan apa yang kami butuhkan dan bersih. Hal-hal lain seperti pengering rambut, kita hanya perlu meminta layanan kamar. Sarapannya juga lezat, terdiri dari masakan tradisional Indonesia yang berbeda dan sarapan ala barat yang sederhana. Secara keseluruhan, kami mendapatkan pengalaman menginap 3 malam yang menyenangkan di Hotel Santika Bogor.
text_review_original: The location is next to Botani Square Mall and center of Bogor, so easy to get foods and do shopping. The hotel provides us with what we need and it is clean. Other things like hair dryer, we just need to ask room service. The breakfast is also delicious, comprised of different traditional Indonesian cuisines and simple western breakfast meals. All in all, we had a pleasant 3 nights stay at Hotel Santika Bogor.

text_review: Pada hari Sabtu saya merencanakan liburan ke Bogor dan memutuskan untuk menginap di Hotel Santika karena lokasinya yang strategis (depan Tugu Kujang dan satu kawasan dengan Botani Square Mall). Saya tiba jam 11 pagi sebelum waktu check-in dan berniat memarkir mobil di area parkir hotel sambil berkeliling mall dulu. Aku tanya dulu ke satpam di lobi hotel dan dia mengarahkanku ke tempat parkir di sebelah mal dan ketika aku sudah ada di sana, satpam lain menolakku dan menyuruhku mencari tempat parkir biasa bersama pengunjung mal lainnya (ya, mal itu ramai banget di akhir pekan) karena tempatnya penuh. Bukankah satu tempat parkir untuk satu tamu merupakan salah satu fasilitas hotel? Dan kalaupun untuk level Hotel Santika, sungguh mengecewakan. Setelah akhirnya sampai di kamar, saya meraba temboknya jadi begini sehingga terdengar suara tetangga saya menyalakan shower, AC mengeluarkan suara aneh, dan bed covernya cukup bau. Selain itu, saya meminta pengering rambut dan kehabisan (saya mendapatkannya keesokan paginya setelah saya mengingatkan staf rumah tangga sekali lagi). Tetap saja saya lega dengan menu sarapan enak yang menawarkan variasi masakan dan kue tradisional Bogor. Namun jika saya bertanya, apakah masa tinggal saya sepadan dengan uang yang dikeluarkan? Tidak. Apakah saya ingin menginap di sini lagi? Tidak terima kasih.
text_review_original: On Saturday, I planned a holiday in Bogor and decided to stay at Hotel Santika because of its strategic location (in front of Tugu Kujang and in the same area with Botani Square Mall). I arrived at 11 A.M which is before check-in period and intended to park the car in hotel parking area while I go around mall first. I asked first to security guard at the hotel lobby and he directed me to parking space next to the mall and when I was already there, another security rejected me and tell me to search for regular parking spot along with other mall visitor (yes, the mall is really crowded on weekend) because the space is full. Isn't it one parking spot for one guest is one of hotel facility? And even if for level of Hotel Santika, it is really disappointing. After finally I got my room, I felt the wall is so this so I can hear my neighbour turn on the shower, the air conditioner make a weird sound, and the bed cover is quite smelly. Besides, I requested for hair dryer and I run out of it (I got it on the next morning after I reminded housekeeping staff once again). Still I relieved with nice breakfast menu that offers variation of Bogor traditional cuisines and cake. But if I ever asked, does my stay is worth the money? No. Do I want to stay here again? No, thank you.

text_review: Kami kecewa karena beberapa alasan: 1. Kami memesan kamar bebas rokok tetapi kami mendapat kamar merokok tanpa informasi apa pun ketika kami check-in atau permintaan maaf apa pun setelah kami mengetahuinya sendiri dan mengonfirmasi bahwa itu adalah kamar merokok. Kami meminta kamar bebas rokok saat kami memesan tetapi mereka mengatakan kamar itu sudah dinetralkan dan tidak ada kata-kata dari mereka untuk menawarkan pindah ke kamar bebas rokok. Bau asap masih ada terutama dari AC walaupun katanya sudah dinetralkan. 2. Area parkir sangat ramai karena menyatu dengan pusat perbelanjaan (Botani Square). 3. Sprei ada noda/kotoran saat kita baru masuk kamar. Kami meminta petugas kamar untuk berganti pakaian.
text_review_original: We were disappointed for some reasons: 1. We booked non-smoking room but we got smoking room without any information when we checked-in or any apology after we knew by ourselves and confirmed it was smoking room. We asked to have non-smoking room as we booked but they said it was neutralized and no any words from them to offer to move to non-smoking room. The smell of the smoke was still there especially from the aircon even they said it had been neutralized. 2. The parking area was very crowded since it was together with shopping center (Botani Square). 3. The bedsheet had some spot/ dirt when we just enter the room. We asked the room boy to change.

text_review: -----PROS----- Lokasi Bagus, di sebelah mal dengan food court, bioskop, dan perbelanjaan Keamanannya bagus Staf sangat baik dan mencoba mengakomodasi. __CONS__ Sarapan biasanya Mayhem, jika Anda datang lebih awal, sarapannya penuh sesak dan terkadang sulit mendapatkan meja, penanak telur terkadang pergi selama beberapa waktu, hanya untuk mengambil telur dalam panci besar. Tidak yakin mengapa ketika harga semakin rendah, seseorang tidak bisa mendapatkan telur-telur ini vs mereka berangkat selama 20 menit pada jam sibuk. Anda sering kali harus berbagi meja dengan orang asing dan kru pembersihan harus meminta meja Anda untuk dibersihkan. ----- KESIMPULAN ---- Saya berada di hotel ini selama 2 minggu untuk bisnis. Ini masih merupakan kesepakatan terbaik di wilayah tersebut.
text_review_original: -----PROS----- Good Location, next to a mall with a food court, movie theater and shopping Security is good Staff is very nice and tries to accommodate. __CONS__ The breakfast is usually Mayhem, if you go early it is packed and at times tough to get a table, the egg cookers sometimes walk away for some time, only to retrieve large pans of eggs. Not sure why when the are getting low, someone cannot get these eggs for them vs them leaving for 20 minutes during rush hour. You often have to share a table with strangers and the cleanup crew you have to ask for your table to be bussed. -----CONCLUSION---- I was at this hotel for 2 weeks for business. It is still the best deal within the area.

text_review: Semuanya memuaskan, kecuali proses check in. Kami tiba pukul 15.30 tetapi kami harus menunggu lebih dari setengah jam agar salah satu kamar kami siap. Lokasi bagus jika Anda perlu banyak berbelanja karena hotel ini berada di lahan yang sama dengan Botany Mall.
text_review_original: Everything was satisfactory, except for the check in process. We arrived at 3.30 pm but we had to wait for more than half an hour for one of our rooms to be ready. Great location if you need to do a lot of shopping since the hotel is on the same lot as Botany Mall.

Strongly recommend.All the staffs are attentive and helpful. I will visit again in the future.

text_review: Lokasi masih menjadi keunggulan terbaiknya (dan satu-satunya), dulunya memiliki fasilitas dan layanan yang bagus atau oke, namun selama bertahun-tahun tampaknya berhasil menyusulnya, dan kunjungan terakhir saya mungkin benar-benar "Yang Terakhir". Pada saat kedatangan saya diberitahu bahwa tidak ada layanan valet, bahwa saya harus berkendara sepanjang kompleks mal ke tempat parkir yang ditentukan di depan mal, di musim puncak ketika daerah itu begitu padat, pasti tidak ada pengalaman yang menyenangkan, jadi saya bersikeras dan membuat wajah tidak senang selama proses check-in dan akhirnya salah satu staf concierge dengan sukarela menawarkan saya untuk membantu memarkir mobil saya. Kemunduran besar lainnya adalah lift, hanya ada 2 dengan masing-masing ruang kecil (hanya muat untuk 4 orang dewasa) dan ketika saya tiba di sana, 1 di antaranya sudah tidak berfungsi, bayangkan saja butuh sekitar 15 menit untuk naik atau turun, bahkan pada waktu sarapan butuh waktu hampir satu jam hanya untuk kembali ke kamar saya :( Ruangan selama bertahun-tahun telah rusak dan memerlukan renovasi dan yang tak kalah pentingnya, AC di resto terus menjatuhkan air ke meja saya.
text_review_original: Location is still its best (and only) strong point, it used to be have fine or ok facilities and services, but over the years time apparently caught up with them, and my last visit might be really "The Last". Upon arrival I was told that there's no valet service, that I need to drive all the way around the mal complex to the designated parking lot in front of the mal, in peak season when area was so packed, surely no fun experience, so I insist and make unhappy face during check-in process and finally one of concierge staff voluntarily offer me to help my car parked. Another major setback is the elevator, it has only 2 with tiny space each (only fit for 4 adults) and by time I got there 1 of them was out of service, just imagine it took about 15 min to go up or down, even at bfast time it took me almost an hour just to get back to my room :( The room over the years have been wearing down and need some renovation and last but not least, AC in resto keep dropping water to my table.

text_review: Kami senang menginap di Santika dan itu adalah puncak perjalanan kami. Itu sangat bersih, Anda bahkan bisa mencium bau disinfektan di lantai lorong setiap hari. Kami tinggal di sana di akhir perjalanan kami semata-mata untuk beristirahat, bersantai dan berbelanja di Botani Square. Sejauh ini hotel terbaik yang kami tinggali selama 3 minggu perjalanan kami. Kedua kalinya menginap di sana dan standarnya masih sama. Luar biasa. Sarapan Anda bisa mendapatkan makanan barat, tetapi makanan Indonesia sangat luar biasa sehingga kami melewatkan makanan barat!! Begitu banyak hal indah untuk dicoba. Sangat menyukai seluruh tempat.
text_review_original: We were delighted to stay at the Santika and it was the highlight of our trip. It was so clean, you could even smell the disinfectant on the floors in the hallways daily. We stayed there at the end of our trip purely to rest, relax and shop at Botani Square. By far the best hotel we stayed at in our whole 3 week trip. Second time staying there an the standard still the same. Wonderful. Breakfast you can get western food, but the Indonesian food was so outstanding we gave the western food a miss!! So many beautiful things to try. Loved the whole place.

Sarapannya berantakan, mungkin sekali lagi karena masuknya pelanggan yang tidak terduga.

text_review: Secara keseluruhan pengalaman menginap kami di hotel ini sangat bagus. Kondisi dan kebersihan hotel bagus, sarapan enak, staf sangat ramah dan pemandangan pegunungan yang indah. Terkoneksi dengan mall dan akses mudah ke tol, sangat nyaman. Secara keseluruhan nilainya bagus. Satu-satunya kemunduran kami adalah mencapai lobi dengan mobil kami. Kami diperlakukan seperti pengunjung mal lainnya. Kami tiba sekitar jam sibuk mal pada akhir pekan. Pintu masuk utama ditutup dengan penjaga keamanan memeriksa mobil mana yang boleh masuk (kami tidak bisa lewat meskipun kami mengklaim check-in ke hotel), kami harus menggunakan pintu samping. Kami tidak tahu di mana letak lobinya, itu sebabnya kami menurutinya (petugas keamanan hanya memberi tahu kami bahwa hotel ini juga dapat diakses melalui pintu samping). Kami harus antri dengan mobil lain untuk mencari tempat parkir di mall. Ternyata lobinya hanya berjarak sekitar 50 meter dari pintu masuk utama tanpa macet. Kami mungkin membutuhkan waktu kurang dari satu menit untuk sampai ke lobi jika mereka mengizinkan kami menggunakan pintu masuk utama, namun kami membutuhkan waktu 30 menit.
text_review_original: Overall our stay at this hotel was great. Good hotel condition and cleanliness, great breakfast, very friendly staff and great view of the mountains. Connected to the mall and easy access to the tollway, very convenient. Overall great value. Our only setback was getting to the lobby in our car. We were treated like other mall visitors. We arrived around the mall's peak hours on a weekend. The main entrance was closed with security guards screening which cars can enter (we didn't get through despite our claim of checking in to the hotel), we had to use the side entrance. We didn't know where the lobby was, that's why we complied (the security guy only told us that the hotel was also accessible via the side entrance). We had to queue with other cars looking for parking space at the mall. It turned out that the lobby was only about 50 meters from the main entrance with no traffic. It could have taken us less than a minute to get to the lobby if they had let us use the main entrance, instead it took us 30 minutes

Breakfast was great, friendly staff.. will stay again at Santika, but I prefer on weekdays..

text_review_original: Rating: 4/5 The room was a bit old but overall okay—clean and well-maintained. The bathroom, especially the shower, worked just fine. Food was decent, nothing special but acceptable. What really stood out was the service. All the staff were kind, warm, and very helpful throughout our stay. One unique perk was the exclusive access to Botani Square, which was a nice touch. The only downside was the lobby. It felt quite small and didn't give off an exclusive or premium vibe, which could be improved. Overall, a comfortable stay with great service!

text_review: Saya tinggal selama dua hari di hotel. Hotel ini sangat sesuai dengan tujuan kunjungan saya, karena lokasinya sangat dekat dengan kebun raya dan menurut saya sangat berguna karena hotel ini terhubung ke pusat perbelanjaan, tempat saya makan dan berbelanja kecil-kecilan di sana. Hotel ini baru dan didekorasi dengan penuh cita rasa, pelayanannya ramah dan efektif, saya juga menemukan berbagai pilihan sarapan, dengan masakan Indonesia dan Barat, luar biasa.
text_review_original: I stayed for two days at the hotel. This hotel served well the purpose of my visit, as it is very well located near the botanical garden and I found it particularly useful that the hotel was connected to a shopping centre, where I had some meals and few small shopping in there. The hotel is new and tastefully decorated, the service is friendly and effectively, I also found the range of breakfast selections, with both Indonesian and Western dishes, fantastic.

text_review: Ruangan itu bersih dan cukup besar. Satu-satunya hal yang kami lewatkan adalah tidak ada mini bar dan rasa menu sarapannya begitu datar.
text_review_original: The room was clean and quite big. The only things we missed were no mini bar and the taste of breakfast menu was so flat.

text_review: Hotel Santika terletak di pusat kota Bogor berdekatan dengan Kebun Raya dan Mall Botani. Banyak restoran di sekitar area tersebut. Kamar yang nyaman dan staf yang ramah. Hanya 1-2 jam perjalanan ke Taman Safari.
text_review_original: Hotel Santika is centrally located in Bogor adjacent to the Botanical Gardens and Botanical Mall. Many restaurants surrounding the area. Comfortable room and friendly staff. Only 1-2 hrs drive to the Taman Safari.

text_review: hotel ini adalah pilihan tepat bagi mereka yang suka berbelanja karena terletak di dalam mal, sangat dekat dengan kebun bunga dan istana presiden bogor yang terkenal. Perlu berhati-hati dengan taksi dan persewaan mobil - karena mungkin akan memakan biaya besar jika Anda tidak bersama teman orang Indonesia. Makanan di bogor dan khususnya hotel ini luar biasa. Pilihan sarapan adalah surga bagi kami. Sampai jam 10 pagi makanan masih tersedia.
text_review_original: this hotel is good choice for those who love to shopping because it is situated inside the mall, very near to the famous kebun bunga and presidential palace of bogor. Need to be carefull with the taxi and car renting- cause it might cost u a bomb if u are not with an indonesian companion.Food in bogor and particularly this hotel is superb. Breakfast choices was heaven for us. Up till 10 am the food is still available.

text_review: pengalaman menginap yang sangat menyenangkan. Semuanya sangat nyaman kecuali saya tidak bisa memesan dua kamar berbeda secara online. Saya membutuhkan 1 kamar dengan 1 tempat tidur besar dan satu lagi dengan dua tempat tidur single dan kedua kamar terhubung. Tapi pokoknya, setelah check-in manajemen berhasil berubah tetapi kamarnya tidak terhubung... Jadi anak-anak saya harus dipisahkan dan agak sulit untuk memantau mereka karena kamar kami tidak terhubung. Oleh karena itu, saya menyarankan agoda untuk meningkatkan sistem pemesanan online agar memudahkan pemesanan bagi tamu seperti saya yang memiliki anak kecil.
text_review_original: Very nice stay. Every thing was very comforting except I couldn't book two different room online. I needed 1 room with 1 big bed and another with two single beds and both rooms connected. But anyway, upon checking in the management manage to change but the rooms are not connected... So my kids had to be separated and a bit difficult to monitor them as our rooms are not connected. Therefore, i suggest agoda to upgrade the online booking system to allow easy booking for guests like me with young children .

text_review: Kelebihan: kamarnya luas dan bersih. perlengkapan mandi dasar disediakan dan toiletnya cukup besar. tempat tidurnya nyaman. TV dengan banyak saluran. AC yang berfungsi dengan baik. meja kerja di dalam ruangan untuk bekerja dan juga sofa mini untuk bersantai. hotel terhubung ke mal di sebelahnya. naik saja lift ke lantai basement dan berjalan melalui koridor pendek. mallnya tidak besar tapi cukup bagus. memiliki bioskop, sejumlah restoran seperti kopi putih kota tua, lotteria, a&w starbucks, coffeebean dan jco. juga memiliki bioskop dan supermarket. ada 'taman bunga' atau kebun raya di depan pintu masuk hotel. staf selalu tersenyum dan ramah. Kontra: 2 lift kecil - dapat menampung 3 orang dengan bagasi atau sekitar 6 tanpa bagasi. wi-fi di kamar bermasalah. cukup sering kehilangan sinyal. TV yang dipasang di dinding berukuran kecil. kira-kira itu hanya TV LED 21".
text_review_original: Pros: the room was spacious and clean. basic toiletries were provided and the toilet was big enough. the bed was comfortable. TV with many channels. good-working air-con. work table in the room to do work and also a mini-sofa to lounge on. hotel was linked to the mall next door. just take the elevator to the basement level and walk through a short corridor. mall was not big but good enough. has a cinema, a number of eateries like old town white coffee, lotteria, a&w starbucks, coffeebean and jco. it also has a cinema and a supermarket. there is a 'taman bunga' or botanic gardens in front of the hotel entrance. staff was always smiling and friendly. Cons: 2 small lifts - can accomodate 3 persons with luggage or about 6 without. wi-fi in room was buggy. lost signal quite frequently. TV mounted on the wall was small. think it's only a 21" LED TV.

text_review: Staf yang sangat ramah. Hanya beberapa menit berjalan kaki dari Terminal Bus Damri (Bus dari Bandara Jakarta). Dekat dengan Botanic Square, pusat perbelanjaan terbesar di Bogor. Sangat mudah untuk menemukan restoran lokal dan internasional. 5 menit berjalan kaki dari Kebun Raya Bogor.
text_review_original: Very friendly staff. It's a few minutes by walking from Damri Bus Terminal (Bus from Jakarta Airport). Close to Botanic Square, the largest shopping mall in Bogor. Very easy to find local and international restaurant. 5 minutes walk from Bogor Botanical Garden.

text_review: Pengalaman menginapnya menyenangkan. Putri saya berenang selama 3 jam di pagi hari dan tidak berhenti. Dengan mudah pergi ke mal tepat di sebelahnya saat diperlukan. Sarapan yang enak. Stasiun antar-jemput bus ke bandara terletak di sebelahnya, berangkat setiap 15 menit.
text_review_original: The stay was nice. My daughter swim for 3 hours in the morning and just wouldn't stop. Easily went to the mall right next to it when needed. Nice breakfast. The bus shuttle station to the airport is located next to it, departing every 15 minutes.

text_review: hotelnya tidak terlalu besar tapi kamar deluxenya lumayan, luasnya sekitar 32 m2 dan bersih. Tempat ini memiliki pemandangan kolam renang dan internet wifi gratis. Hotel ini terletak di mal Botani Square, jadi Anda tinggal turun ke lobi dan berjalan kaki ke mal jika butuh makan atau sekadar jalan-jalan. Depan hotel ada Kebon Raya Bogor yang terkenal dengan koleksi pohonnya dan enak untuk jalan-jalan.
text_review_original: the hotel is not too big but the deluxe room is not bad, its around 32 m2 and it is clean. It has pool view and wifi internet free. The hotel is located at the Botani Square mall, so you just go down the lobby and walk to the mall if you need something to eat or just walk around. In front of the hotel is Kebon Raya Bogor, it is famous for it's tree collection and nice to walk around.

text_review: Kami menginap selama 1 malam untuk melarikan diri dari padatnya kota Jakarta dan menjelajahi kebun raya. Hotel ini sangat dekat dengan taman, sekitar 5 menit berjalan kaki. Tamannya indah dan sangat santai dan layak untuk dikunjungi. Hotel ini bersih dan sederhana dan meskipun sedikit mahal untuk apa yang Anda dapatkan tetapi itu memiliki tujuan. Sarapan sangat ramai dan kacau tetapi pilihan yang bagus dan staf restoran ramah dan senang membantu. Mereka bahkan membiarkan kami memasak pancake sesuai keinginan kami dan itu enak. Spa yang terpasang di hotel itu mahal untuk apa yang Anda dapatkan dan meskipun ramah, pijatannya tidak terlalu bagus. Jika Anda pergi ke Bogor untuk mengunjungi Kebun Raya maka Anda bisa melakukan hal yang jauh lebih buruk daripada bermalam di Santika.
text_review_original: We stayed for 1 night to escape the crowded city of Jakarta and to explore the botanic gardens. The hotel is very close to the gardens, about a 5 minute walk. The gardens are beautiful and very relaxing and worth the visit. The hotel was clean and basic and although a little expensive for what you get but it served a purpose. The breakfast was very crowded and chaotic but a good selection and the restaurant staff were friendly and happy to help. They even let us cook our pancakes the way we like which was nice. The spa attached to the hotel was expensive for what you get and although friendly the massage was not particularly good. If you go to Bogor for the Botanical gardens then you could do a lot worse than stay at Santika for a night.

text_review: Saya pernah menginap di grup hotel Santika di Indonesia, seperti Malang dan Balikpapang. Sama seperti hotel lainnya, staf Santika bogor terlatih dan ramah. Kamarnya sederhana tapi oke untuk menginap. WiFi berkecepatan tinggi dan cukup stabil. Hotel terletak tepat di sebelah pusat perbelanjaan Anda bisa mendapatkan semuanya di sana.
text_review_original: I have stayed Santika hotel group in indonesia, such as Malang and Balikpapang. As same as other hotel, staff of Santika bogor are well trained and friendly. A room is simple but OK for staying. WiFi is high speed and stable enough. Hotel is just next to shopping center you can get everything there.

text_review_original: It was very good , it was my first vist to Bogor. I like this hotel, for it location to the mall. The staff were friendly. The room, is very comfortable, big bed, clean barthroom.

text_review_original: Santika hotel is the best place in Bogor that i would like to suggest. Come with DAMRI (AIRPORT BUS) and park directly in Hotel area. text_review: Staf Hotel Santika termasuk yang ramah, paling ceria dan suka membantu yang akan Anda temukan. Benar-benar menawan dan ramah, dengan senyuman yang selalu siap sedia! Lokasinya juga bagus, cukup jalan kaki ke Kebun Raya Bogor dan terminal bus bogor, serta berdekatan dengan IPB dan pusat perbelanjaan yang bagus. Hotel ini cerah, modern, bersih, dan terawat dengan baik. Sarapan prasmanan sangat enak. Tempat tidur, seprai, dan bantal sangat bagus. Tapi, kenapa semuanya begitu kecil di hotel ini? Lobi kecil. Kamarnya kecil. Kamar mandinya kecil. TV kecil. Ruang lemari terbatas. "Pusat kebugaran" kecil. Jika Anda tertarik untuk mengurangi jejak karbon, ukuran kecil dari hotel ini akan menarik. Hotel ini hanya memiliki dua lift yang lambat, jadi menunggu bisa lama hanya untuk naik dan turun. Dindingnya tipis; lorong-lorong berisik dan membanting pintu bisa mengganggu. Secara keseluruhan, hotel ini memiliki beberapa aspek yang sangat bagus dan beberapa di antaranya agak membuat frustrasi. Tergantung pada apa yang penting bagi Anda, hotel ini bisa menjadi luar biasa atau mengecewakan. Rata-rata: rata-rata hingga baik.
text_review_original: The staff of Hotel Santika are among the friendlist, most cheerful and helpful you will find anyway. Absolutely charming and hospitable, with ever-ready smiles! The location is also great, walking distance to the Bogor Botanical Gardens and the Bogor bus terminal, and adjacent to IPB and a nice shopping center. The hotel is bright, modern and clean, and well maintained. Breakfast buffet is very good. Beds, linens and pillows are excellent. But, why is everything so small at this hotel? Lobby is small. Rooms are small. Bathrooms are small. TVs are small. Closet space is limited. "Fitness center" is small. If you're interested to reduce your carbon footprint, the smallness of this hotel will appeal. The hotel has only two slow lifts, so waits can be long just to get up and down. Walls are thin; hallways are noisy and banging doors can be annoying. Overall, this hotel has some very nice aspects and some that are rather frustrating. Depending on what's important to you, this hotel can be wonderful or disappointing. On average: average to good.

text_review: Saya sangat menyukai hotel bergaya modern dengan kamar dan koridor yang besar - yang saat ini hanya ada sedikit di Bogor. Pilihan dan kualitas makanan terhadap harga yang diminta jelas lebih sedikit. Ada pusat kebugaran yang kecil namun memadai dan kolam renang yang besar, yang tentu saja jarang digunakan dan tersedia bagi beberapa olahragawan yang menjadikannya lebih baik. Hotel ini bersebelahan dengan pusat perbelanjaan besar yang melayani sebagian besar jenis makanan termasuk makanan barat, Jepang, dan Korea. Namun staf meja depan harus belajar bagaimana menangani permintaan tamu, dan selalu memperbaruinya dan tidak hanya membuat janji kosong dan selanjutnya tetap diam - misalnya. seperti yang dialami saat internet terputus dalam waktu lama. Secara keseluruhan, penawaran yang bagus untuk harganya dan dengan pemandangan gunung yang indah di bagian belakang hotel di pagi hari.
text_review_original: I really liked the modern style hotel with large rooms and corridors - of which there are presently just few in Bogor. Food choice and quality against the prices asked was definitely less. There is a small but adequate fitness and large pool, which of course is hardly used and available to those few sporters which makes it only better. Hotel is adjacent to a large shoppign center which caters for most types of food including western, japanses and korean food.. Front desk staff however have to learn how to deal with guest requests, and keep them updated and not just make empty promises and next stay quiet- e.g. such as experienced during a prolonged internet failure All in all a good deal for the price and with a beautifull mountainview on the back of the hotel in the morning.

The beds are very comfortable and the bathroom sleek. text_review: Keluarga saya memutuskan untuk liburan akhir pekan dari Jakarta yang ramai.. Nah, yang pertama kami pergi ke Novotel mencari tanaman hijau, kali ini kami memilih Santika untuk bagian 'kota' Bogor. Yang paling kami nikmati adalah variasi sarapannya. Bagian buruknya bagi saya adalah mereka mengadakan resepsi pernikahan di dekat kolam renang pada hari kedua kami..yang agak aneh karena para tamu agak memperhatikan kami berenang dan bahkan beberapa anak mereka berenang tanpa pakaian renang yang layak. Selain itu, ini adalah liburan yang menyenangkan.
text_review_original: My family decided to have a weekend getaways from the bustling Jakarta.. Well, the first one we went to Novotel looking for the greenery, this time we opted Santika for the 'city' part of Bogor. What we enjoyed the most was the variety of the breakfast. The down part for me was they had a wedding reception near the pool on our second day..which a bit odd since the guests kinda watched us swimming and even some of their children swam without proper swimming clothing. Else than that, it was an enjoyable holiday.

text_review_original: the convenience surrounding the hotel is the best point i have to say. the shopping centre, eateries, the botanical garden, the local market and the nice mountain view all add to a pleasant experience during my stay. the breakfast spread was indeed superb. do try the sunda food at a nearby latisa restaurant, 600 metres away from the hotel. it is fantastic.

text_review: Secara personal, saya akan berpikir dua kali untuk menginap di hotel ini di masa depan.
text_review_original: In personnel, I will think twice to stay to this hotel in future.

text_review: Lokasi bagus, di sebelah Botanic Square dengan terowongan penghubung langsung bawah tanah. Restorannya sangat enak dengan sarapannya tapi kami tidak terlalu senang dengan kualitas makan malam prasmanan dan makan malam a la carte. Sangat rata-rata dan terlalu mahal untuk apa yang kami dapatkan. Layanan binatu sangat buruk - kaus kaki saya dikirim masih sangat basah, beberapa kemeja bisnis memiliki banyak lipatan meskipun telah disetrika. Harus berdebat dengan resepsionis untuk mendapatkan uang kembali untuk kaus kaki basah. Saya merasa mereka seharusnya menawarkan pengembalian dana tanpa saya harus menghabiskan 10 menit berdebat di konter. Setelah mengatakan semua ini, pengalaman menginap secara keseluruhan menyenangkan.
text_review_original: Good location, next to Botanic Square with an underground direct connecting tunnel. The restaurant was very good with the breakfast but we were not too happy with the quality of the dinner buffet and a la carte dinner. Very average and overpriced for what we got. The laundry service was appaling- my socks were delivered still very wet, a few business shirts had lots of creases albeit been ironed. Had to argue with the receptionist to get money back for the wet socks. I felt they should have offered the refund without me having to spend 10 mins arguing at the counter. Having said all these, the stay was pleasant overall.

text_review: Ruangan itu bersih dan nyaman. Kualitas makannya tidak bagus untuk makan malam tapi cukup bagus untuk sarapan. Layanan binatu buruk - setrika perlu ditingkatkan.
text_review_original: The room was clean and comfortable. Dining quality wasn't great for dinner but quite good for breakfast. Laundry service was poor- the ironing needs to be improved.

text_review: Hotel ini sangat bagus, staf yang hebat dan membantu. Sarapannya luar biasa: begitu banyak pilihan; makanan tradisional Indonesia, sarapan ala Amerika dan kontinental. Akses sangat mudah ke mall di sebelahnya, bahkan tidak perlu keluar rumah! Lokasinya bagus, tepat di depannya ada kebun raya (daya tarik utama) dan mall di gedung yang sama. Kendalanya cuma baunya saja, di beberapa titik tercium bau yang sangat khas dari kamar mandi. Kalau tidak, kamar bagus dengan ruang yang cukup, tapi TV kecil.
text_review_original: The hotel is very nice, great and helpful staff. The breakfast is amazing: so much to choose from; traditional indonesian food, american and continental breakfast. Very easy acces to the mall next to it, no need to go outside even! The location is good, just in front is botanical garden ( main attraction) and mall in the same building. The only problem was the smell, at some point a very distinctive smell seemed to come from the bathroom. Otherwise nice rooms with enough space, but small tv's.

text_review: kami tinggal selama satu malam dan cukup senang dengan kami tinggal. kamar superior luas tapi tidak terlalu kedap suara. pemandangan gunung menggantikannya. hotel ini memiliki wifi berkecepatan tinggi gratis dan pilihan sarapan yang baik. hotel ini terletak di sebelah mal sehingga nyaman untuk mengambil minuman dan makan di luar.
text_review_original: we stayed for a night and was pretty happy with our stay. superior room was spacious but not very sound proof. mountain view made up for it though. hotel has free high speed wifi and a good spread for breakfast. hotel is next to a mall so convenient for picking up drinks and eating out.

text_review: sebagian besar kami mendapatkan pengalaman menginap yang menyenangkan, namun kami tidak dapat tidur pada malam kedua karena tamu di atas kami sangat berisik sepanjang malam dengan musik keras dan hentakan kaki. karena sudah larut malam dan kami sudah berada di tempat tidur, kami mencoba menghubungi meja depan, manajer malam, dan operator berkali-kali dan tidak mendapat tanggapan. kami akhirnya tertidur tetapi bangun lagi pada jam 5 pagi karena musik keras yang sama, suara-suara dan suara seperti furnitur sedang dipindahkan. kami menelepon meja depan lagi dan seseorang akhirnya mengangkatnya, meskipun yang mereka katakan hanyalah mereka akan memeriksanya! tidak ada tindak lanjut dan ketika kami pergi ke meja depan tidak ada catatan keluhan kami dan kami hanya ditawari kopi gratis sebagai kompensasi. karena kami belum tidur, kami terlambat memulai hari dan meminta untuk check-out lebih lambat, yang tampaknya banyak yang harus ditanyakan tetapi kami akhirnya boleh check-out beberapa jam kemudian di sore hari. secara keseluruhan kami menikmati hotel ini untuk kunjungan singkat, tetapi kurangnya kemampuan staf untuk menangani situasi secara memadai dan yang lebih penting, kurangnya staf yang bertugas di malam hari membuat saya tidak ingin kembali lagi.
text_review_original: for the most part we had a great stay, however we could not sleep the second night as the guests above us were incredibly noisy all night with loud music and stomping. as it was late and we were already in bed we tried dialing the front desk, the night manager and the operator numerous times and got no response. we finally fell asleep but woke up again at 5am to the same loud music, voices and what sounded like furniture being moved. we called the front desk again and someone finally picked up, though all they said was that they would look into it! there was no follow up and when we went to the front desk there was no record of our complaint and we were only offered complimentary coffees as compensation. because we had not slept we were late getting a start on the day and asked to have late check-out, which was apparently a lot to ask but we were finally ok'd to check out a few hours later in the afternoon. overall we enjoyed the hotel for a quick visit, but the lack of the staffs ability to adequately deal with the situation and more importantly the complete lack of staff on duty at night made me not want to come back again.

text_review: Rating: 4/5 Ruangannya agak tua tapi secara keseluruhan oke—bersih dan terawat. Kamar mandi, terutama shower, berfungsi dengan baik. Makanannya lumayan, tidak ada yang istimewa tapi bisa diterima. Yang benar-benar menonjol adalah layanannya. Semua staf ramah, hangat, dan sangat membantu selama kami tinggal. Salah satu fasilitas uniknya adalah akses eksklusif ke Botani Square, yang merupakan sentuhan yang bagus. Satu-satunya kekurangannya adalah lobi. text_review_original: Rating: 4/5 The room was a bit old but overall okay—clean and well-maintained. The bathroom, especially the shower, worked just fine. Food was decent, nothing special but acceptable. What really stood out was the service. All the staff were kind, warm, and very helpful throughout our stay. One unique perk was the exclusive access to Botani Square, which was a nice touch. The only downside was the lobby. It felt quite small and didn't give off an exclusive or premium vibe, which could be improved. Overall, a comfortable stay with great service!

text_review: aku sebenarnya mendapat upgrade ke kamar deluxe. saya bersenang-senang menginap di santika bogor. kamarnya luas dan bersih, terletak membelakangi mal botani square. layanan kamar sangat baik, makanan enak dan lezat tetapi porsinya agak kecil untuk saya. tempat menginap yang bagus untuk liburan dan bisnis karena koneksi wifi sangat baik. satu-satunya hal yang saya tidak suka adalah kenyataan bahwa kamarnya tidak kedap suara. suara-suara dari lorong dan musik dari tepi kolam agak mengganggu. jika tidak, saya menikmati masa menginap saya di santika bogor dan saya pasti akan kembali lagi nanti jika saya datang ke bogor.
text_review_original: i was actually got ugraded to a deluxe room. i had a great time staying at santika bogor. the room is spacious and clean, located back to back to botani square mall. the room service was excellent, good and delicious foods but the portion was a bit small for me. good place to stay for holiday and business as the wifi connection was excellent. the only thing i did not like is the fact that the rooms are not sound proof. voices and noises from the hallway and musics from the poolside were a bit disturbing. otherwise i enjoy my stay at santika bogor and i will definitely come back next time i come to bogor.

text_review: preferensi kami adalah menginap di novotel, tetapi karena mereka tidak menawarkan bkf, kami memutuskan untuk memilih santika. jika itu keputusan yang bagus, karena harganya masuk akal, kamarnya terang dan lapang, bersih dan modern, bkf memiliki semua yang kami harapkan dan banyak lagi. karena terletak di sebelah mal besar, menyenangkan juga untuk menghabiskan sedikit waktu di malam hari.
text_review_original: our preference was to stay at the novotel, but since they did not offer bkf, we decided to opt for santika. if was a great decision, as the price was reasonable, room was bright and airy, clean and modern, bkf had everything we expected and more. being located next to a large mall, it was also great to while a bit of time away in the evenings.

text_review: Sarapan enak, hotel bagus, staf ramah, dekat mal, lokasi bagus, senang menginap di sini lagi,
text_review_original: Good breakfast, nice hotel , frendly staff ,, near to the mall ,, good location , love to stay here again ,

text_review: Kamarnya sangat bagus, sarapannya enak. Ini memiliki ruang kebugaran dan kolam renang yang bagus. jangan berenang di pagi hari kecuali Anda ingin berenang di depan beberapa ratus orang yang sedang sarapan. Internet bisa menjadi baik.
text_review_original: The rooms are very nice, the breakfast great. It has a nice fitness room and swimming pool. don't do an early morning swim unless you want to swim infront of several hundred people eating cbreakfast. The internet can be good.

text_review: satu hal yang kami sukai menginap di santika, mereka menyediakan makanan lokal untuk sarapan di samping makanan standar lainnya. Anda akan mencicipi makanan lokal yang berbeda dari Indonesia ketika Anda tinggal di kota yang berbeda. selama kami menginap di Santika Bogor, kami tidak memiliki keluhan apa pun. itu luar biasa, kami mendapat kamar terhubung yang kami minta, semua staf sangat membantu. Kami menikmati masa menginap kami di sini seperti hotel santika lain yang pernah kami kunjungi sebelumnya.
text_review_original: one thing we love staying with santika, they provide local food for breakfast beside other standard food. You'll taste different local food from indonesia when you stay in different city. for our staying at Santika Bogor, we didnt have any complaint. it was great, we got connecting rooms we asked, all staffs were helpful. We enjoyed our stay here like other santika hotel we have stayed before.

We no need to worry about the transport and time during our stay in Bogor. Almost everything we could get them there...

text_review: susah banget dicari, lokasi tidak bisa dijangkau jika tidak mempunyai mobil pribadi, ada baiknya untuk beristirahat dan bersantai
text_review_original: very hard to find, the location can not be reach if you don't have private car, it is good to take a rest and relax

text_review: Hotelnya terhubung dengan pusat perbelanjaan, jadi nyaman. Namun kualitas fasilitas dan sarapannya tidak sebaik yang diharapkan dari harga tersebut. Sulit untuk naik taksi untuk berkeliling, bahkan meminta pelayan untuk melakukannya.
text_review_original: The hotel is connected to a shopping mall, so it is convenient. However, the quality of facilities and breakfast is not so good as expected from this price. Difficult to catch a taxi to go around, even asked bell boys to do so.

text_review: lokasi bagus karena bisa lewat langsung ke mall, tapi area parkir untuk tamu sangat buruk.
text_review_original: good location bcoz can pass directly to mall, but the parking area for guests is very bad.

text_review: Hotel ini terletak di dekat atau di dalam Botany Square di pusat kota Bogor. Area drop-off di depan lobi terlalu kecil dan tidak nyaman. Tapi untungnya semua staf sangat membantu sehingga kami dibantu dalam mengantar dan memarkir mobil kami secara keseluruhan selama kami menginap. Ruangannya sebenarnya cukup besar dan luas, yang membuat pengalaman menginap kami bersama anak kecil cukup menyenangkan. Sarapannya juga cukup enak. Kolam renangnya tidak besar tetapi cukup untuk anak-anak kami berenang sambil bersenang-senang sambil ayah dan ibu menikmati sarapan. Karena sangat dekat dengan mal, sangat mudah bagi kami untuk mendapatkan apa pun yang kami perlukan, makanan, obat-obatan, dll. Kamar dan lobi hotel terlihat cukup baru atau mungkin sudah diperbaharui. Namun liftnya sangat kecil. Hanya ada 2 lift dan satu hanya muat untuk maksimal enam orang. Namun, kami sangat menikmati kunjungan kami dan kami pasti akan menginap di sana lagi jika kami mengunjungi Bogor lagi di masa mendatang. Kami juga akan merekomendasikannya kepada orang lain.
text_review_original: The hotel is located near or inside the Botany Square in the center of Bogor. The drop-off area in front of the lobby is too small and not convenient. But luckily all the staff were very helpful so we were assisted in dropping-off and parking of our car the whole during our stay. The room was actually quite big and spacious, which made our stay with our young children quite enjoyable. The breakfast was also quite nice. The swimming pool was not big but enough for our children to have fun swimming while mom and dad enjoyed breakfast. Being so close to the mall, it was very easy for us to get whatever we needed, food, medicines, etc. The rooms and the hotel lobby looked quite new or maybe refurbished. The elevators however, were very small. There were only 2 lifts and one fit only for six people maximum. However, we enjoyed our stay very much and we would definitely stay there again if we ever visit Bogor again in the future. We also would recommend it to other people.
